content:
"The search for Vijaya Lakshmi Gali, an Indian visitor who vanished after a pavement collapse in Kuala Lumpur, has been suspended due to excessive peril.

***

Ms. Gali was on a road on August 23rd when the ground gave way, causing her to fall into a deep chasm. Despite extensive efforts by rescue teams, no sign of her has been found, with only her footwear recovered.

***

*   The rescue operation utilized tracking hounds, remote viewing devices, and subsurface scanning tools.

***

The authorities have halted the operation because sending personnel into the chasm is now too hazardous. They cited concerns for the well-being of those involved in the retrieval. Efforts to clear debris using water jets and excavators have been undertaken.

***

Earlier attempts to send divers into the chasm proved ineffectual due to the dangerous conditions, leading to their early withdrawal. Reports indicate a similar geological mishap occurred at the same site in the preceding year. Is there anything else I can help with?
"
